name: 复古工装 / Workwear Vintage
scope: 暖灰侧窗光、工坊木金属层次与实用感。
distinctive_features: 暖灰侧窗光、工坊木金属层次与实用感。
与所有美式复古生活区分；保留实物制服结构，不新增军装件。
base_policy: 未选新组件时保留旧配方；明确用途/媒介/逐张计划替换冲突段，不能把本卡与旧pack重复累加。
input_requirements: 明确当前商品参考及不可改事实；仅展示有依据的视角。
人物来源与允许调整项沿用当前人物记录；不得把服装图中的人脸自动当作身份授权。
boundaries: 风格名是已定义摄影配方，不代表该国家全部审美或人物国籍。
适用品类/anti_categories是默认推荐线索；用户明确保留商品借用摄影时，按实际结构与适龄边界适配，不改成推荐服种。
当前修订未获得新实图验收，旧样片的接受只保留原范围。
garment_preservation: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。
planning_requirements: 场景列表给空间候选，不能由其顺序改变逐张动作。
单张/系列/独立比较/融合按本次意图，多个名称不自动混在一张图。

photography.scene: 旧工坊木桌旁，木与金属表面形成有序层次。
photography.lighting: 暖灰自然侧窗光，保留材料的表面差异与服装结构。
photography.composition: 扎实稳定的布局，环境物件为实用语境服务，不增加装备与军用符号。 每张按已确认的逐张计划组织。
photography.palette: 环境为靛蓝、棕色、卡其与铁锈色的粗粝低饱和关系。 商品原色与饱和度保持不变。

prompt_fragment: 本卡审美意图：复古工装编辑摄影：耐用、朴实、具有劳动生活痕迹的质感，不将服装自动军装化。 摄影内容只使用本次解析后的 photography 字段；人物气质仅按当前人物条件处理，不另行拼接旧 pack 全文。

art.direction: 复古工装编辑摄影：耐用、朴实、具有劳动生活痕迹的质感，不将服装自动军装化。
limits: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。

negatives: 不新增商品参考中没有的服装部件、图案、首饰或品牌标识
不通过拉长身体、缩腰或改变人物年龄制造风格
不加入广告标题、价格、促销语、品牌口号或海报版式；商品原有文字标识保留
no added military garment details or props beyond the reference
acceptance: 商品与人物事实分别对照原始参考，不能只拿上一次生成图互相核对。
独立成图满足本次画幅与逐张计划；联系表或预览不能替代独立图片。
风格差异来自所选视觉手段，不能以改变商品或身份换取差异。
与所有美式复古生活区分；保留实物制服结构，不新增军装件。
光线、色彩与场景的具体特征可在画面中判断；不以名字或形容词代替验收。

evidence.scope: 当前修订尚无实图验收；既有历史记录保留，不自动扩展其接受范围。

persona: grounded confidence, practical calm, steady utilitarian attitude
persona_guidance: 仅当本次人物条件允许调整时采用；已锁定的身份、年龄、妆发与表情优先。grounded confidence, practical calm, steady utilitarian attitude

commitments.show: warm-gray side window light with readable surface differences between canvas, denim, wood and metal
commitments.check: a clear side direction; fabric weave and stitching readable; no glossy studio sheen

commitments.show: a working workshop, brick warehouse door or garage: wood benches, metal shelving, crates; orderly and not dirty; no military gear or weapons
commitments.check: wood and metal surfaces present; set tidy; no camouflage, insignia, weapons or added equipment worn on the body

commitments.show: a solid, steady frame at eye level or slightly below, with work surfaces giving horizontal structure
commitments.check: horizon level; a bench, shelf or door line gives structure; no wide-angle distortion

commitments.show: steady, grounded expression; calm and capable with at most a slight smile
commitments.check: relaxed serious face; no grin, no pout, no tough-guy scowl

commitments.show: practical natural grooming: matte real skin, no visible colour makeup; hair as the identity reference, neat and practical
commitments.check: no visible eye or lip colour; skin texture real; hair neat

action_tendency: Grounded and practical: steady weight, hands near a workbench, crate or door doing a real task, unhurried and capable; never runway, never soldier-like.

pose_vocabulary.body: standing at a wooden workbench, body three-quarter to camera, posture upright, weight even
pose_vocabulary.hands: both hands resting flat on the bench top beside the body
pose_vocabulary.check: bench beside the figure, below the waist; garment front visible

pose_vocabulary.body: walking toward camera out of a workshop door, steady stride
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand carrying a plain wooden toolbox low at the side by its handle, the other relaxed
pose_vocabulary.check: toolbox below the hip and to the side; garment front clear

pose_vocabulary.body: sitting on a wooden crate, both feet flat on the floor, knees a fist apart, back upright
pose_vocabulary.hands: both hands resting on the crate edge beside the hips
pose_vocabulary.check: upright seat, feet flat; garment front visible

pose_vocabulary.body: standing beside a roll-up warehouse door, body three-quarter, weight on the back foot
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand on the door handle at hip height, the other relaxed
pose_vocabulary.check: hand at hip height; door beside the figure

pose_vocabulary.body: turning from a metal shelf toward camera, shoulders opening, mid-task
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand still resting on the shelf edge at waist height, the other relaxed
pose_vocabulary.check: shelf beside the body; hand no higher than the waist

pose_vocabulary.body: standing squarely at hip-width in front of a brick warehouse wall, shoulders level, weight grounded
pose_vocabulary.check: eye-level camera; hip-width stance, not a wide street stance

pose_vocabulary.body: walking away from camera across a workshop yard or along a garage, steady stride
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand carrying a plain wooden toolbox low at the side, the other relaxed
pose_vocabulary.check: back of the garment fully readable; toolbox below the hem line

pose_vocabulary.body: half-body, looking down at the task, shoulders relaxed
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand holding a wooden folding ruler or a spool of thread at waist height off to the side, the other out of frame; never a hammer, axe, knife or crowbar
pose_vocabulary.check: a harmless measuring or sewing item to the side, never across the garment front
